proof_body:
by
  intro f fx fy hx hy cx cy p
  have hxF : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (s, v.2)) (fx v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) v.1 := fun v => by
    have h := (hx v).hasFDerivAt
    have e : ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (fx v) = fx v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := by
      ext
      simp
    rw [e] at h
    exact h
  have hyF : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (v.1, s)) (fy v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) v.2 := fun v => by
    have h := (hy v).hasFDerivAt
    have e : ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (fy v) = fy v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := by
      ext
      simp
    rw [e] at h
    exact h
  have ccx : Continuous fun v : ℝ × ℝ => fx v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := cx.smul continuous_const
  have ccy : Continuous fun v : ℝ × ℝ => fy v • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ := cy.smul continuous_const
  have key := hasStrictFDerivAt_uncurry_coprod (𝕜 := ℝ) (u := p)
    (f := fun x y => f (x, y))
    (f₁ := fun x y => fx (x, y) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
    (f₂ := fun x y => fy (x, y) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hxF) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hyF)
    ccx.continuousAt ccy.continuousAt
  have h : HasFDerivAt f _ p := key.hasFDerivAt
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  ext <;> simp [Function.HasUncurry.uncurry]
target_source: ∀ (f fx fy : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (s, p.2)) (fx p) p.1) → (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (p.1, s)) (fy p) p.2) → Continuous fx → Continuous fy → ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, HasFDerivAt f (fx p • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + fy p • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p
